title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
While pasta cooks, sauté garlic in olive oil until golden, add red pepper flakes.
Toss pasta with oil, garlic mix and chopped parsley.
Serve hot.

title: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Cut chicken into strips.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar, ginger, garlic to make teriyaki sauce.
Sear chicken until cooked then pour sauce and reduce until thick.
Serve chicken over rice, sprinkle sesame seeds and chopped spring onions.

title: Vegan Buddha Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa and roast sweet potato until tender.
Rinse and drain chickpeas, lightly season and bake if preferred.
Assemble quinoa in bowl, add kale, sweet potato, chickpeas, avocado slices.
Drizzle with tahini dressing.

title: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: Pre‑heat oven to 250°C.
Stretch dough onto pizza peel.
Spread tomato sauce, top with mozzarella slices and fresh basil leaves.
Drizzle olive oil and sprinkle salt.
Bake 10‑12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese bubbly.

title: Beef Tacos with Pico de Gallo
instructions: Cook ground beef with diced onion and taco seasoning until browned.
Warm taco shells.
Make pico de gallo by mixing diced tomato, onion, cilantro, lime juice, salt.
Assemble tacos with beef, lettuce, cheese, pico de gallo.

title: Thai Green Curry with Tofu
instructions: Heat a little oil, fry green curry paste until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and bring to simmer.
Add tofu, bamboo shoots, bell pepper, lime leaves.
Cook until vegetables tender.
Season with fish sauce or soy sauce, garnish with Thai basil.
Serve with jasmine rice.

title: Salmon Teriyaki Salad
instructions: Mix soy sauce, honey, ginger to marinate salmon for 10 minutes.
Pan sear salmon until cooked through, set aside.
Toss salad greens, cucumber, carrot ribbons, drizzle rice wine vinegar and olive oil.
Top salad with salmon, sprinkle sesame seeds.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
instructions: Pre‑heat oven to 200°C.
Melt chocolate and butter together.
Whisk eggs, sugar, vanilla until pale, fold in melted chocolate mix, then flour.
Pour into greased ramekins.
Bake 10‑12 minutes until edges set but center is gooey.
Serve immediately.

title: Greek Moussaka
instructions: Pre‑heat oven to 190°C.
Fry eggplant and potato slices until softened.
Cook lamb with onion, garlic, tomato paste until done.
Layer potatoes, eggplants, lamb mix in baking dish.
Top with béchamel and grated cheese.
Bake ~40 minutes until golden on top.
Let rest before serving.

title: Avocado & Banana Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend avocado, banana, almond milk, spinach, honey until smooth.
Pour into bowl.
Top with chia seeds and granola.
Serve chilled.

title: Baked Ziti with Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Cook pasta until al dente and drain.
Mix pasta with marinara sauce and ricotta.
Transfer to baking dish, top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake 20–25 minutes until cheese melted and golden.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve.

title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente, drain and reserve some pasta water.
Heat olive oil in pan, sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add shrimp, cook until pink and opaque.
Add lemon juice, parsley, and reserved pasta water.
Toss pasta with shrimp and sauce.
Serve immediately.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices alternately on a plate.
Place basil leaves between slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve fresh.

title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper, grill until cooked through.
Chop romaine lettuce and place in bowl.
Slice chicken and place on top of lettuce.
Add croutons and sprinkle Parmesan cheese.
Drizzle with Caesar dressing and toss lightly.
Serve immediately.

title: Beef Stir‑Fry with Vegetables
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok or large pan.
Add garlic and ginger, sauté until fragrant.
Add beef strips, cook until browned.
Add vegetables and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Pour soy sauce and toss everything together.
Serve hot with rice or noodles.

title: Vegetable Frittata
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in oven-safe pan, sauté vegetables until softened.
Pour egg mixture over vegetables, sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake 15–20 minutes until eggs are set.
Slice and serve warm.

title: Teriyaki Salmon with Rice
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar, garlic, ginger to make teriyaki sauce.
Pan-sear salmon fillets until cooked through.
Pour teriyaki sauce over salmon and simmer for 2–3 minutes.
Serve salmon over rice, garnish with chopped spring onions.

title: Pancakes with Maple Syrup
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk eggs with milk, then combine with dry ingredients.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan.
Pour batter to form pancakes, cook until bubbles form, flip and cook other side.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
Sauté onion and ground beef in olive oil until browned.
Mix beef with cooked rice and tomato sauce.
Stuff mixture into bell peppers, top with cheese.
Bake 25–30 minutes until peppers tender and cheese melted.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Cream butter, sugar, and brown sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs and vanilla extract, mix well.
Combine flour, baking soda, and salt, then fold into wet ingredients.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Scoop onto baking tray and bake 10–12 minutes until golden.
Cool before serving.

title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Heat olive oil in pan and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add mushrooms and cook until softened.
Add rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Gradually add vegetable broth, stirring frequently until rice is creamy and cooked.
Stir in butter and Parmesan, season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot.

title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Heat olive oil in pan, sauté chicken with taco seasoning until cooked.
Add bell peppers and onion, cook until tender-crisp.
Warm tortillas in a pan or oven.
Assemble fajitas by placing chicken and vegetables in tortillas.
Serve with lime wedges.

title: Quinoa Salad with Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Toss vegetables with olive oil, salt, and pepper, roast 20 minutes.
Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Combine roasted vegetables with quinoa.
Drizzle lemon juice and sprinkle feta and parsley on top.
Serve warm or chilled.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente and drain.
Heat butter and olive oil in pan, sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add shrimp, cook until pink.
Stir in lemon juice and parsley.
Toss spaghetti with shrimp mixture.
Serve immediately.

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Cook veggie patties according to package instructions or grill.
Toast burger buns lightly.
Assemble burgers with lettuce, tomato, onion, patty, and cheese.
Add ketchup and mustard to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Spicy Tofu Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat sesame oil in pan, sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add tofu cubes, cook until lightly browned.
Add vegetables and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Pour soy sauce and chili sauce, toss to coat.
Serve hot with rice or noodles.

title: Margherita Flatbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Place flatbread on baking tray.
Spread tomato sauce on flatbread.
Top with mozzarella slices and basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper.
Bake 8–10 minutes until cheese melts.
Serve warm.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in pot.
Add chicken and cook until tender, then remove and shred.
Add vegetables to broth, cook until tender.
Return shredded chicken to pot.
Add noodles, cook until al dente.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with parsley.
Serve hot.

title: Avocado Toast with Egg
instructions: Toast bread slices until golden.
Mash avocado, season with salt and pepper.
Spread avocado on toast.
Fry or poach eggs and place on top.
Sprinkle chili flakes if desired.
Serve immediately.

title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Mash bananas in a bowl.
Add oats, chocolate chips, vanilla extract, and cinnamon, mix well.
Scoop onto baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Bake 12–15 minutes until golden.
Cool before serving.

title: Spinach and Feta Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Line pie dish with pie crust.
Sauté spinach until wilted and cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, pepper, and nutmeg together.
Add spinach and feta to egg mixture.
Pour mixture into pie crust.
Bake 30–35 minutes until set and golden.
Cool slightly before serving.

title: Thai Peanut Noodles
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to package instructions and drain.
Whisk together peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, and garlic.
Toss noodles with sauce.
Add carrot and cucumber, mix well.
Top with cilantro and crushed peanuts before serving.

title: Beef Bolognese
instructions: Heat olive oil in pan and sauté onion, garlic, carrot, and celery until softened.
Add ground beef, cook until browned.
Pour in tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Serve sauce over spaghetti and sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Grilled Vegetable Skewers
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.
Thread vegetables onto skewers.
Brush with olive oil, season with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Grill for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally until charred and tender.
Serve hot.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Heat oil in pan, sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and cook until browned.
Stir in curry powder and cook for 1–2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, add vegetables if desired.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
Serve hot with rice.

title: Caprese Panini
instructions: Preheat panini press or grill pan.
Layer mozzarella, tomato, and basil between bread slices.
Drizzle lightly with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill panini until bread is golden and cheese melts.
Serve warm.

title: Baked Salmon with Lemon
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Place salmon on baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle garlic, salt, pepper, and herbs.
Place lemon slices on top of salmon.
Bake 12–15 minutes until cooked through.
Serve hot.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Sauté zucchini and spinach with olive oil until softened.
Spread a thin layer of marinara sauce in baking dish.
Layer lasagna sheets, vegetables, ricotta, and sauce.
Repeat layers and top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake 35–40 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Shrimp Tacos
instructions: Toss shrimp with taco seasoning.
Sauté shrimp in pan until pink and cooked through.
Warm taco shells.
Assemble tacos with shrimp, cabbage, avocado, and sour cream.
Garnish with cilantro and lime wedges.
Serve immediately.

title: Pumpkin Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in pot, sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add pumpkin cubes and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to boil, then simmer until pumpkin is tender.
Blend soup until smooth.
Stir in cream, season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Serve hot.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Combine cucumber, tomato, red onion, feta, and olives in a bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.
Serve chilled.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente.
Heat olive oil, sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add vegetables and cook until tender-crisp.
Toss spaghetti with vegetables.
Sprinkle Parmesan, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

title: Teriyaki Salmon
instructions: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar, ginger, and garlic to make teriyaki sauce.
Marinate salmon fillets for 10–15 minutes.
Pan-sear salmon until cooked through, pouring in sauce to reduce and glaze.
Garnish with chopped spring onions and serve.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a pan, sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 5–7 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add soy sauce and toss to coat.
Serve hot with rice or noodles.

title: BBQ Chicken Wings
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Toss chicken wings with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Place on baking tray and bake 25 minutes.
Brush BBQ sauce on wings and bake another 10 minutes until cooked and sticky.
Serve hot.

title: Mango Smoothie
instructions: Combine mango, banana, yogurt, milk, and honey in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into glass and serve chilled.

title: Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a pan, sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add beef strips, cook until browned.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 3–5 minutes.
Add soy sauce and toss to coat.
Serve hot with rice or noodles.

title: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Melt chocolate and butter together.
Whisk eggs, sugar, and vanilla until pale.
Fold in melted chocolate and then flour.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake 20–25 minutes until set.
Cool before slicing and serving.

title: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in pan, sauté onion and carrot until tender.
Push vegetables aside, scramble eggs in pan.
Add cooked rice and peas, stir-fry to combine.
Add soy sauce and toss well.
Serve hot.

title: Lemon Drizzle Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Cream butter and sugar until pale.
Beat in eggs one at a time.
Fold in flour, baking powder, lemon zest, and juice.
Pour into greased cake tin.
Bake 25–30 minutes until golden.
Cool before serving.

title: Quinoa Salad with Avocado
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions and let cool.
In a bowl, combine quinoa, avocado, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and parsley.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper together.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.
Serve chilled.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft, add ground beef and cook until browned.
Mix beef with cooked rice and tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper.
Stuff mixture into bell peppers, top with cheddar cheese.
Bake 25–30 minutes until peppers are tender and cheese is melted.
Serve hot.

title: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast bread slices until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread avocado mixture on toasted bread.
Sprinkle chili flakes if desired.
Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Chop romaine lettuce and place in a large bowl.
Slice grilled chicken breast.
Add chicken, croutons, and Parmesan to lettuce.
Drizzle Caesar dressing and toss gently.
Season with salt and pepper, serve immediately.

title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter in pan, sauté onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add mushrooms and cook until softened.
Add arborio rice and stir for 1–2 minutes.
Gradually add vegetable broth, stirring continuously, until rice is creamy and cooked.
Stir in Parmesan, season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk in milk and eggs until smooth batter forms.
Heat a non-stick pan with butter.
Pour batter in small circles and cook until bubbles appear.
Flip and cook the other side until golden.
Serve with syrup or toppings of choice.

title: Shrimp Fettuccine
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Toss cooked fettuccine with shrimp and garlic oil.
Sprinkle Parmesan and parsley, season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately.

title: Veggie Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté vegetables until tender.
Pour eggs over vegetables and cook until set.
Fold omelette and serve hot.

title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Heat olive oil in pan, sauté chicken with taco seasoning until cooked.
Add bell peppers and onion, cook until slightly tender.
Warm tortillas.
Assemble chicken and vegetables in tortillas, serve with lime wedges and sour cream.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°C.
Mash bananas in a bowl.
Cream butter and sugar, then mix in eggs and vanilla.
Fold in mashed bananas and flour with baking powder.
Pour batter into greased loaf tin.
Bake 50–60 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool before slicing.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices alternately on a plate.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Pour in tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper, simmer 15 minutes.
Serve sauce over spaghetti, sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter in a pan.
Add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add shrimp, season with salt and pepper, cook until pink.
Drizzle with lemon juice, sprinkle parsley.
Serve hot.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes, cook 5 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth, season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with basil leaves and serve hot.

title: Beef Burger
instructions: Form ground beef into patties, season with salt and pepper.
Cook patties in a skillet or grill until desired doneness.
Toast burger buns.
Assemble burger with lettuce, tomato, onion, cheese, and patties.
Add ketchup and mustard, serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Sauté zucchini and spinach in olive oil until tender.
Layer lasagna sheets, vegetables, ricotta, and tomato sauce in baking dish.
Top with mozzarella cheese.
Bake 30–35 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Serve hot.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil, add chicken breast and cook until done.
Remove chicken, shred, and set aside.
Add carrot, celery, onion, and garlic to broth, simmer 10 minutes.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Return shredded chicken to soup, season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Cream butter, sugar, and brown sugar together.
Beat in egg and vanilla extract.
Fold in flour, baking soda, salt, and chocolate chips.
Scoop onto baking tray and bake 10–12 minutes until golden.
Cool before serving.

title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer Greek yogurt in a glass or bowl.
Add granola on top of yogurt.
Add a layer of mixed berries.
Drizzle honey over the top.
Serve immediately.

title: Teriyaki Tofu Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a pan, sauté garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Add tofu cubes, cook until golden on all sides.
Add vegetables and stir-fry 5–7 minutes.
Pour soy sauce over stir-fry and toss to coat.
Serve hot with rice or noodles.
